prompts.electric:
Edit/recompose using the electric paper atlas as STYLE reference only. Produce ONLY a new single complete TALL rear-stage paper facade, transparent background, square image 1536x1536. No atlas grid, no floor tile, no isolated props. The structure must fill x 5%-95% and y 5%-92%, be almost as tall as wide, and have a domed/arched outer silhouette with a horizontal bottom baseline. This fits inside the tall lid of a spherical paper Pokeball.
Subject: Pokémon Emerald Mauville electric gym as rich overlapping FLAT cut-paper stage scenery. Keep teal/ochre palette, lightning badge, cream cut edges and paper fibers from reference. Redesign rather than stretching existing image: lower third electrical switchboards and grated gates; middle tier paired yellow insulating columns and paper wire conduits, central lightning emblem; upper half magnificent layered domed roof trusses, cables, insulators, warm hanging lamps, deep teal electrical panels. Many distinct overlapping paper strips and shallow layers, a tangible PAPER THEATRE, NOT 3D model or realistic factory, not voxel. Every circular motif remains circular. Front-on view with only shallow depth suggested by overlap and contact shadows. No floor extending toward viewer. No characters, text, shell or mirror. Complete silhouette with clear transparent margin, nothing clipped.

Keep clear compositional hierarchy, abundant distinct overlapping FLAT cut-paper layers and thin cream edges, matte paper grain and subtle contact shadows. Pure crafted paper theatre rather than 3D architectural model. Three narrow turquoise water spillways on lower wall for shader animation, warm lanterns. No characters, letters, Pokeball shell, glass or mirrors. Straight front view and shallow drawn perspective only.
